description: This file defines an abstract base class `StateMachineTestBase` used for setting up and managing state machine tests in the Orleans framework. It includes setup for dependency injection, serializers, logging, and provides methods to create in-memory storage and manage lifecycle components for tests.

classes.name: StateMachineTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for setting up state machine testing environment with dependency injection, logging, and serialization support.

classes.name: GrainLifecycle
classes.description: Private nested class implementing lifecycle behavior for testing, inheriting from LifecycleSubject and implementing IGrainLifecycle.

methods.name: StateMachineTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependency injection services, serializers, and logging.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates an in-memory storage implementation for testing.

methods.name: CreateTestSystem
methods.description: Creates and returns a tuple with a state machine manager, storage, and lifecycle component for testing.
